topics.name: Natural language processing methods
topics.summary: Natural-language studies build ITSM and rural-clinical pipelines, simulate mental-health interactions, generate theorem-prover scripts, and harden agent defenses, showing how language models move into operational domains.

topics.name: Control systems, signal processing, and communications
topics.summary: Control and communication studies pair learned dynamics with signal processing, feedback, or network models; simulations and hardware-oriented tests measure stability, robustness, and efficiency under changing inputs and delays.

topics.name: Agent memory and personalization
topics.summary: Agent-memory studies organize personal context, episodic traces, and preference signals for adaptive assistance; experiments show that selective retention and personalized retrieval can improve usefulness while limiting irrelevant or sensitive history.

topics.name: Language-model safety and alignment
topics.summary: Language-model safety work studies privacy-preserving retrieval, watermark provenance, model routing, medical vision systems, and challenge benchmarks, balancing protection, traceability, and retained task capability.

topics.name: Vision-language reasoning and grounding
topics.summary: Vision-language work grounds language decisions in images, video, or 3D structure using cross-modal encoders and spatial evidence; benchmarks expose remaining gaps in fine-grained localization, reasoning, and domain transfer.

topics.name: Test-time reasoning and search
topics.summary: Test-time reasoning methods use evolutionary search, analog-circuit adaptation, multi-policy feedback, interaction-driven skill updates, and generative embeddings to spend inference compute where it can change decisions.

topics.name: Time series forecasting and streaming adaptation
topics.summary: Forecasting studies adapt temporal models to nonstationarity, streaming data, and changing horizons; experiments report better calibration or transfer when recent context and shift detection guide updates.

topics.name: Robot navigation and embodied agents
topics.summary: Embodied navigation combines affordance grounding, outdoor accessibility, future-map imagination, visual-inertial estimation, and predictive driving dynamics, testing transfer from controlled scenes to physical environments.

topics.name: Efficient model inference and compression
topics.summary: Efficiency studies reduce inference cost through pruning, quantization, caching, routing, or compact architectures; matched benchmarks show that memory savings are useful only when quality and latency remain stable across workloads.

topics.name: Object detection, segmentation, and recognition
topics.summary: Perception systems use multi-scale features, open-world supervision, and geometry-aware fusion for detection or segmentation; results on natural, medical, and remote-sensing data highlight robustness to missing labels and domain shift.

topics.name: LLM capability benchmarks
topics.summary: Benchmark papers build controlled tasks, human or automatic rubrics, and trace-level metrics for language-model capabilities; their evaluations reveal where headline scores conceal failures in verification, reasoning, or real-world use.

topics.name: Robotic manipulation and dexterous control
topics.summary: Embodied-control studies cover open-vocabulary navigation, planetary multi-robot coordination, cooperative AUV pose estimation, socially compliant motion, and vision-based contact sensing.

topics.name: Optimization, operations research, and algorithms
topics.summary: Optimization research ranges from federated matrix updates and quantum resource planning to pruning, robust distribution summaries, and black-box denoising, with constraints used to keep efficiency gains usable.

topics.name: Diffusion and generative image models
topics.summary: Diffusion work studies controllable image, video, and speech generation with conditioning, distillation, or temporal structure; perceptual and downstream tests weigh fidelity, diversity, coherence, and sampling cost.

topics.name: Interpretability and representation analysis
topics.summary: Interpretability papers probe hidden features, causal mechanisms, and representation geometry with interventions or diagnostic benchmarks; findings connect measurable internal structure to transfer, bias, and model behavior.

topics.name: LLM training, adaptation, and data curation
topics.summary: Training studies compare adaptation recipes, data selection, and continual updates across language and multimodal models; results show that curation and objective design can matter as much as parameter count.

topics.name: Grounded and verifiable language models
topics.summary: Grounding studies link generated claims to retrieved evidence, formal checks, or external tools; evaluations show improved faithfulness when models can abstain or verify intermediate conclusions instead of relying on confidence alone.

topics.name: Tool-using and software agents
topics.summary: Tool-using agent studies connect language models to software interfaces, code execution, and task traces; experiments show that explicit planning and verification reduce brittle behavior on long workflows.

topics.name: Other machine learning methods
topics.summary: These machine-learning studies combine structured representations with probabilistic or optimization-based objectives; experiments demonstrate useful generalization while identifying assumptions that limit deployment.

topics.name: Embodied agents and world models
topics.summary: Embodied-agent work treats provenance and parallel reasoning as control problems, asking whether agents can preserve trustworthy state while acting, observing, and revising plans.

topics.name: Medical imaging and clinical vision
topics.summary: Medical-vision studies address visual generalization, tractography, concept bottlenecks, segmentation uncertainty, and longitudinal MRI reasoning, emphasizing interpretable evidence and robustness across scans and patients.

topics.name: Information retrieval, RAG, and recommendation
topics.summary: Retrieval and recommendation work combines dense representations, reranking, graph context, or preference modeling; domain benchmarks show that query intent and evidence quality govern usefulness beyond recall alone.

topics.name: Language understanding and generation
topics.summary: Language understanding work combines emotion datasets, verified retrieval, knowledge-graph grounding, and instruction-tuning audits, measuring how confidence, lexical variety, and domain evidence shape generated responses.

topics.name: LLM safety and reliability evaluation
topics.summary: Safety and reliability benchmarks span clinical temporal reasoning, anomaly retrieval, federated backdoors, pose estimation, and video forgery, using disagreement and attack analyses to expose hidden failure modes.

topics.name: Fairness and social bias in language models
topics.summary: Fairness studies audit demographic and social bias in language systems using targeted datasets and counterfactual or representation-level tests; results show that aggregate accuracy can hide uneven behavior across groups and tasks.

topics.name: Language-model reasoning methods
topics.summary: Reasoning studies compare prompting, search, reinforcement, and verifier-guided refinement on complex tasks; results show that extra deliberation helps selectively and can fail when objectives reward the wrong intermediate behavior.

topics.name: Multilingual NLP and machine translation
topics.summary: Multilingual studies cover Thai speech conversion, Sinhala-Tamil retrieval, Bavarian cultural grounding, transactional code prompts, and remote-sensing reference resolution, stressing regional and cross-modal transfer.

topics.name: 3D vision, point clouds, and spatial reconstruction
topics.summary: Spatial-vision work reconstructs geometry, point clouds, or scenes with multi-view features and learned priors; experiments emphasize efficiency and robustness to sparse observations, occlusion, and sensor variation.

topics.name: Multi-agent coordination and collaboration
topics.summary: Multi-agent research represents collaboration with roles, communication graphs, or shared environments; evaluations find that coordination quality depends on interaction structure and failure recovery, not only individual model competence.

topics.name: Multimodal information extraction and document intelligence
topics.summary: Document-intelligence systems align text, layout, images, and tables for extraction or reasoning; benchmark results show that structural cues and cross-modal verification improve reliability on long or heterogeneous documents.

topics.name: Information retrieval and search
topics.summary: Search-oriented systems plan geo-distributed LLM infrastructure, operationalize cyber-threat knowledge with graph retrieval, and use generated graph structure to improve local optimization.

topics.name: Reinforcement learning and decision making
topics.summary: Reinforcement-learning studies shape exploration, rewards, and policy updates for sequential decisions; simulations and real-world tasks show gains when feedback reflects safety, uncertainty, and long-horizon utility.

topics.name: Agent planning and orchestration
topics.summary: Agent-planning work uses decomposition, execution feedback, and adaptive orchestration for long tasks; evaluations report stronger completion and recovery when planning remains coupled to observed progress.

topics.name: Causal inference and statistical learning
topics.summary: Causal and statistical studies combine identification, uncertainty, and structured prediction to separate associations from actionable effects; analyses clarify how robustness changes under shift, missingness, or intervention.

topics.name: Healthcare, biosignals, and biomedical prediction
topics.summary: Biomedical prediction work combines spectral sensing, coupled tensor structure, and translational neuroscience to connect measurements with crop quality, biological mechanisms, and personalized health.

topics.name: Speech, audio, and spoken language
topics.summary: Speech and audio studies model acoustic context, separation, and spoken interaction with temporal or multimodal encoders; evaluations focus on recognition quality, robustness to noise, and faithful generation.

topics.name: Video generation and video understanding
topics.summary: Video research combines temporal representations, diffusion, retrieval, or language grounding for generation and understanding; experiments measure coherence, event localization, and robustness over long sequences.

topics.name: Education, human factors, and social computing
topics.summary: Human-centered studies use user data, interaction logs, and controlled evaluations to examine education, trust, or social computing; findings show that interface scaffolding and context shape outcomes as much as model accuracy.

topics.name: Molecular, materials, and computational chemistry
topics.summary: Molecular and materials studies use learned representations, simulation, and chemical structure data to predict properties or transformations; results emphasize transfer across compounds and the value of physically meaningful constraints.
